title: Job
description: A job represents a single execution of a job template, tracking the playbook run status, timing, and output.

id.description: The unique identifier of the job.

status.description: The current execution status of the job.

elapsed.description: The elapsed time in seconds for job execution.

job_template.description: The ID of the job template that was executed.

inventory.description: The ID of the inventory used for this job.

project.description: The ID of the project used for this job.

created.description: The date and time the job record was created.
